title: Steam Deck Screen + Stick Protector Cover Case
author: jamie_
description:
Even more helpful than boosting, please **follow me on MakerWorld**for new models and updates in the future.

\\_\\_\\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

PETG only, as PLA is harder than the Steam Deck ABS. As requested on **my one piece Steam Deck case**… A multi-piece print Steam Deck case for travel that enables printing with components laid flat on the print bed. This mitigates any warping issues found with printing vertically, and allows convenient AMS logos to be printed on the front of the cover. **Fits both LCD and OLED models.**

1. First-of-kind clips on top edge to stop side-to-side movement.
2. Half a millimetre screen cavity carved out, so the plastic case doesn't rub on the screen.
3. No supports required.
4. Vent holes and USB-C port exposed, so you can charge it while it's protected.
5. Logo printed on the front.

If you're not using my print profiles:

- **Seam position on back** for cleaner appearance
- **Concentric top surface pattern** for a nicer finish on the tops of the thumb stick protectors

For extra protection, grab some 0.5mm thick adhesive foam to place inside the screen cavity.
